scope: Real touch in lobby, launch, Debug and generator. Foundry gets 120 fixture coins; all other choices use normal UI.

checks.name: Lobby detects touch and keeps stations collapsed
Lobby joystick walks the actual commander
Lobby one-finger look turns the camera
Lobby pinch zoom changes viewing distance
Commander choice persists through touch selection
Foundry roll spends coins once and adds one tower
Lobby launches the selected commander and mount into the campaign
Debug leaves most of the portrait viewport to the scene
Debug one-finger orbit rotates a real exhibit
Debug controls open with the first tap after a gesture
All horizontally scrolling category buttons are reachable
Landscape Debug has no horizontal page overflow
World generator starts collapsed for touch inspection
Worldgen formation selection focuses its actual camera
Touch form generates a different world
